[\"一个单调减栈maxs记录j左侧第一个比它大的元素（即所有可能买入点的左边界.en: A monotonically decreasing stack `maxs` records the first element on the left of `j` that is larger than it (that is, the left boundary of all possible buying points), while another monotonically increasing stack `mins` records all possible buying points on the left of `j` (that is, starting from it to `j`, it always remains the minimum value in the sequence). Therefore, during the process of updating `mins`, you can directly use binary search to find the longest left boundary for each right boundary. During the monthly exam, I directly derived the first element on the left that is larger than it and the first element on the right that is smaller than it, and then brute-forced the enumeration.
